name: secure-signer
description: Non-custodial Solana WebAuthn signing iframe (trusted origin). Assumes the parent is XSS-compromised.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/assert-no-inline.mjs dist/index.html
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && cp deploy/_headers dist/_headers && pnpm cf:deploy
